text:
maya (Growth PM): Quick sync — launching the Benchmark webinar + newsletter push next week. Need CTA rotation plan, segmentation rules, and who owns the send setup.

owen (Content): I can draft 3 CTA copy variations: Demo→Book, Benchmark→Read, Compare→See pricing. Short lines, clear verbs.

maya (Growth PM): Perfect. We'll rotate CTAs across segments to avoid cannibalizing opens. Thinking 3 variants x 3 segments.

priya (Email Ops): Can the ESP handle 3x3 matrix? We should keep sample sizes reasonable. Suggest allocation: 60% main, 20% altA, 20% altB per segment, then send a winner to remainder after 24h.

jules (Analytics): 60/20/20 is fine. We'll run early-click significance after 24 hours and promote winner. Make sure we log click_id and campaign parameters.

sam (Design): I'll prepare 3 visual CTAs (primary button styles) and a text-only fallback. Need final copy by EOD Wednesday.

maya (Growth PM): Segments — propose: power_users, trialers, recent_signups. Rules below.

```
power_users:
  event: api_request
  timeframe: 30d
  tokens: ">100000"

trialers:
  signed_up: 90d
  converted: false
  trial_started: true

recent_signups:
  signed_up: 30d
  last_active: null
```

priya (Email Ops): Those are implementable. Add an exclusion: unsubscribed and marked_do_not_market. Also exclude attendees of the last webinar within 90d.

owen (Content): Subject line candidates for the A/Bs: 1) "New benchmarks for LLM inference costs" 2) "How teams cut inference cost by 3x" 3) "Benchmark results + what they mean for your app". Thoughts?

jules (Analytics): Subject 2 might bias toward cost-sensitive folks — keep for trialers. We should rotate subjects across segments too but keep it to 2 variants to limit combinatorics.

maya (Growth PM): OK: subject A/B across all segments, CTA variants per segment. So final matrix: 2 subjects x 3 CTAs x 3 segments = 18 sends; ESP will map into 2 subject buckets, then CTA variations per segment.

priya (Email Ops): Tracking: utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_content={cta_variant}_{segment}_{subjectA|B}. Use {click_id} macro.

sam (Design): For mobile, make CTA primary color #0b5fff, fallback text link in plain HTML.

priya (Email Ops): Schedule windows: power_users -> Tue 10am PT, trialers -> Wed 9am PT, recent_signups -> Thu 11am PT. Stagger by 24h to smooth infra load.

maya (Growth PM): Who's owning the ESP build? @priya?

priya (Email Ops): I'll own the build. @sam send final assets. @owen finalize copy by EOD Wed. @jules will validate analytics events.

owen (Content): Noted. I'll post the final subject/preview + body copy in this thread when done.

jules (Analytics): Quick ask — add a secondary KPI: downstream signups from CTA clicks (30d lookback). We'll tag clicks with click_id so we can tie back.

priya (Email Ops): Added to tracking plan. Also setting up a holdback of 10% audience for a control baseline.

maya (Growth PM): Great. Deliverables checklist: 
- Copy finalized (owen) 
- CTAs & assets (sam) 
- ESP build + exclusions + tracking (priya) 
- Analytics validation (jules) 
- Launch readiness review (maya)
Deadline: Fri COB.

sam (Design): I'll drop assets into the marketing drive and ping here when done.

priya (Email Ops): Build started. ESP preview URLs: https://esp-preview.company/il/1984202468/previewA , https://esp-preview.company/il/1984202468/previewB

owen (Content): Copy posted: https://docs.company/benchmark-launch-copy (comments open).

jules (Analytics): I'll run a quick preflight tomorrow to confirm event hooks.

maya (Growth PM): One last thing — can we rotate CTA order within the email for power_users so we surface "Compare" more often? Maybe 50% position A, 50% position B.

priya (Email Ops): ESP supports dynamic content ordering. I'll implement position rotation for power_users only.

ci-bot: Campaign build completed and linted — campaign_id=cmp_1984202468, status=staged.

priya (Email Ops): Awesome — I'll kick off a small test send to internal list after approvals.

maya (Growth PM): Thanks team. Final approvals by Friday 3pm PT please.

ci-bot: Scheduled send windows set. Next action: @priya to trigger final send.
